item.title: Best Methods for Importing CSV Data into PostgreSQL Tables
item.description:
“Best Methods for Importing CSV Data into PostgreSQL Tables”

How can one efficiently transfer data stored in a CSV file into a defined structure within a PostgreSQL database? Several expert methods exist, leveraging native database features, command-line utilities, and external programming libraries. Here is an examination of these approaches.

Technique 1: The Native COPY Command

The standard, server-side method for bulk loading data is the PostgreSQL COPY SQL command. This requires the file to be accessible directly by the database server process.

item.title: R Techniques for Converting Excel Serial Dates to Standard Date Format
item.description:
“R Techniques for Converting Excel Serial Dates to Standard Date Format”

When importing data from Microsoft Excel into R, especially using older formats or direct numeric imports, dates often appear as serial numbers (e.g., 42705). This number represents the count of days since a specific epoch, typically December 30, 1899, for the Windows version of Excel. How can we reliably reverse this transformation in R across various packages?

Here we detail several robust methods to convert these numeric representations into valid R Date or POSIXct objects.
